thread:
Ana: Quick sync  I'm drafting the deprecation email + redirect plan for the v1 retire. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/640. Need a couple quick reviewers and infra signoff on redirects.

Devon: Looks good. Can we include a tiny FAQ about redirects (how long they'll last, what to expect) and an example showing how clients should handle a 410? e.g.:
```
# curl example showing 410 handling
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/text-gen/outputs -d '{"input":"hi"}'
# HTTP/1.1 410 Gone
# Retry should be to v2 endpoints or update SDK
```

Riley: Also call out the deprecation header behavior for older SDKs. Old servers will add `X-Redwood-Deprecation` with a short message. Example in Python: 
```
resp = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
if resp.status_code == 410 or resp.headers.get('X-Redwood-Deprecation'):
    # log and start migration flow
    print('v1 deprecated, see docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/guides/v1-to-v2')
```

infra-bot: Redirect rule scheduled by infra: `/v1/* -> /v2/compat/*` (temporary) active window 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-15. Please ensure docs have merit link and compat page.

docs-bot: link-checker: broken anchor found in docs/deprecations/v1-retire.md -> missing `#faq-redirects`.

Ana: I'll add the FAQ section and include a short table: redirect window, expected 301 vs 410 behavior, and how to detect programmatically. Also adding a note about CI/API keys: rotate keys if pinned to legacy SDK versions.

Devon: Add an automated migrator reference (tools/migrate-v1-to-v2.sh) and a tiny usage example so teams can test in a sandbox. Also add a changelog callout so SDKs can point users to the migration page.

Riley: Suggest a monitoring recipe: baseline 301/410 counts, alert when >1% of traffic hits 410 after 2026-06-20. Include a quick Grafana query example in the doc.

Ana: Proposed timeline at top of doc: announce + migration docs by 2026-04-15, soft warnings enabled in SDKs by 2026-05-15, redirect window 2026-06-01..2026-06-15, final retire 2026-07-01. Approve?

Devon: Approved from product. I'll add the changelog entries in the SDK release PRs.

Riley: Approved from infra and reliability. We'll keep redirect logs for 90 days after retire.

docs-bot: preview build passed for PR #640  all checks green.

Ana: Merged PR #640. Thanks everyone :pray: If anything urgent pops up ping me here and I'll open a follow-up.
